import 'package:state_kit/state_kit.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/core/app_config.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/core/app_scope.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/core/app_copy.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/core/screen_layout.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/features/onboarding/onboarding_bloc.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/features/onboarding/onboarding_state.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/features/shared/rename_sheet.dart';
import 'package:kit_ui/kit_ui.dart';

/// The last screen: setup is done.
class ReadyPage extends StatelessWidget {
  const ReadyPage({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = KitColors.of(context);
    final scope = AppScope.of(context);
    final bloc = context.read<OnboardingBloc>();
    return BlocSignalBuilder<OnboardingBloc, OnboardingState>(
      builder: (context, state) {
        final shown = state.selected.take(3).toList();
        final first = state.selected.isEmpty
            ? null
            : state.names[state.selected.first];
        final count = state.selected.length < AppConfig.freeItemLimit
            ? state.selected.length
            : AppConfig.freeItemLimit;
        return PinnedBottomColumn(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(KitSpace.l, KitSpace.x3, KitSpace.l, 42),
          bottom: KitButton(
            label: 'Open the app',
            onPressed: () => bloc.add(const BoardConfirmed()),
          ),
          children: [
            KitBoardScene(
              items: [
                for (final id in shown)
                  KitBoardItem(
                    asset: scope.catalog.byId(id).riveFile,
                    artboard: scope.catalog.byId(id).riveArtboard,
                    label: _NameLabel(
                      name: state.names[id]!,
                      onTap: () async {
                        final renamed = await showRenameSheet(
                          context,
                          currentName: state.names[id]!,
                        );
                        if (renamed != null) {
                          bloc.add(ItemRenamed(id, renamed));
                        }
                      },
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
              onItemLanded: (_) => scope.haptics.medium(),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 28),
            Semantics(
              header: true,
              child: KitBalancedText(
                "You're all set",
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: KitType.display.copyWith(color: c.ink),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Center(
              child: ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 300),
                child: Text(
                  first == null
                      ? 'You can add more items anytime.'
                      : 'We named them for you. Tap a name anytime to change '
                            'it. $first is first on the list today.',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: KitType.lede.copyWith(color: c.ink2),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: KitSpace.m),
            Wrap(
              alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
              spacing: 8,
              runSpacing: 8,
              children: [
                KitStatusChip(
                  label: count == 1 ? '1 item' : '$count items',
                  tone: KitStatusTone.neutral,
                ),
                KitStatusChip(
                  label: AppCopy.time(state.time),
                  tone: KitStatusTone.neutral,
                ),
                KitStatusChip(
                  label: AppCopy.homeModeSummary(state.mode),
                  tone: KitStatusTone.neutral,
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _NameLabel extends StatelessWidget {
  const _NameLabel({required this.name, required this.onTap});

  final String name;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = KitColors.of(context);
    return KitPressable(
      onTap: onTap,
      semanticLabel: 'Rename $name',
      builder: (context, pressed) => ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: KitSize.minTap),
        child: Center(
          child: Text(
            name,
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: KitType.sceneName.copyWith(color: c.ink),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
